projecthero.spin.ability.steel_ball.desc: Throw the ball in your main hand up to 30 blocks. On its way out it curves after your aim: look where you want it to go, and flick your crosshair onto a creature to bend it in (the turn can't be too sharp). It hits for 10 damage and spins its body for 3 seconds: it staggers about and can't aim. The ball always flies back into your hand. With an empty main hand, R calls back a ball you dropped or left in a chest. 15 Spin.
projecthero.spin.ability.twin_balls.desc: Needs a ball in each hand. Throw both at once: they curve in from either side onto where you aim and keep following your crosshair on the way out. 10 damage each, and each comes back to its own hand. 30 Spin.
projecthero.spin.ability.scan.desc: Set the ball in your main hand spinning on the ground. For 8 seconds every creature and player within 40 blocks glows gold through walls, for you alone. The ball hops back into your hand after 2 seconds. 15 Spin.
projecthero.spin.ability.spin_quake.desc: Hammer the ball in your main hand into the ground: 14 damage to everything within 6 blocks, knocked off their feet and slowed for 2 seconds. 25 Spin.
projecthero.spin.ability.spin_shield.des: Needs a ball in each hand. Both balls leave your hands and orbit you for 4 seconds. They knock arrows, bullets and fireballs away and hit anything that comes close for 4 damage, then drop back into your hands. 30 Spin.
message.projecthero.spin.acquired_hint: Your two Steel Balls are in your hands: keep one in your main hand for most moves, one in each hand for Twin Balls and Spin Shield. R throws one. Hold Shift+G and let go as the gold rectangle lines up for a Perfect Spin. Shift+X whistles for your horse, Valkyrie. Open the Guidebook (Other Heroes) for every move.
message.projecthero.spin.need_ball: Hold a Steel Ball in your main hand
message.projecthero.spin.need_balls: Hold a Steel Ball in each hand
message.projecthero.spin.recall: Your Steel Ball flies back to you
message.projecthero.spin.ball_destroyed: A Steel Ball was destroyed. A new one comes in 30 seconds
projecthero.guide.spin.balls.body: Learning the Spin gives you two Steel Balls, and the moves need you to hold them. Keep a ball in your main hand for Steel Ball, Spin Touch, Golden Spin, Ball Breaker, Scan, Spin Quake, Healing Spin and Face Spin, and one in each hand for Twin Balls and Spin Shield; Spin Leap and Valkyrie need none. Without them a move does nothing and is greyed out on the HUD. A thrown ball leaves your hand and flies back into the same hand (or a free slot if you've filled it). The balls are yours alone: you keep them when you die, nobody else can pick them up, and with an empty main hand R calls back a ball you dropped or left in a chest. A ball destroyed in lava or the void comes back by itself after 30 seconds.
projecthero.guide.spin.commands.body: Operators: /projecthero power tune spin spin <0-100>, balls (a new pair of Steel Balls; older ones vanish), cooldowns.
